title: Hans Zimmer
extract: Hans Florian Zimmer is a German film composer and music producer. He has received numerous accolades, including two Academy Awards, a BAFTA Award, three Golden Globe Awards, and five Grammy Awards as well as nominations for seven Emmy Awards. Zimmer was also named on the list of Top 100 Living Geniuses, published by The Daily Telegraph in 2007.
